head: c39347e3
ux_applicability_justification: This phase is migration/seed/deploy-governance work: CLI tooling (migration-ledger-doctor), seed helper extraction (codecamp-seed selectLessonsToInsert), seed script idempotency fixes (sales, science grade-4), and Red/Green test infrastructure. There is no user-facing UI, no HTTP API endpoint contract change, no tRPC router modification, and no form or page flow change. The closest contract surface is the migration-ledger-doctor CLI's exit codes and labeled stderr messages, which form a developer/deploy operator contract (not a UX contract). Seed scripts emit operator-facing console.log output but these are internal tooling messages, not user-facing flows.

exit_codes.exit_0: No divergence found; all checks pass; required-migration gate OK
exit_codes.exit_1: Divergence found; required migration behind; tag not in journal (typo); repair still divergent
exit_codes.exit_2: Usage error; DIRECT_DATABASE_URL missing; journal read failure; DB connection failure; unhandled error

contract_messages: Required migration behind count: N — required tag "<tag>" (idx K, when T) but highest applied ledger when is X (<entries> are not applied)
Required migration gate OK — "<tag>" (when T) is at or below highest applied when X
Required migration behind count: 0 — required tag "<tag>" is not in _journal.json (typo or stale pipeline config)
migration_ledger_doctor_cli.documentation: JSDoc on parseRequiredMigration() documents flag + env var; usage line updated; plan.md documents contract
migration_ledger_doctor_cli.assessment: Well-defined. Exit codes are coherent: 0=ok, 1=fail-closed (behind/divergence/typo), 2=usage/connection. Messages are labeled and grep-parseable for CI branching. The 'behind count: 0' for tag-not-in-journal is semantically confusing but exit 1 is correct for fail-closed behavior.

seed_script_output.codecamp_seed: console.log with emoji labels (✅, ✏️, ➕, 🗑️, 📦) and labeled counts (Seeded N new module(s), N existing module(s) updated, N orphaned exercise-repo rows removed)
seed_script_output.assessment: Acceptable for internal tooling. No formal output contract required.

codecamp_seed_tests.command: CI=true pnpm --filter @reading-advantage/db exec vitest run src/__tests__/codecamp-stale-seed.test.ts

nonblocking_observations: The 'Required migration behind count: 0 — required tag not in _journal.json' message uses count:0 with exit 1. Semantically confusing for grep-based CI checks, but exit code is correct for fail-closed. Not a defect — the tag-not-in-journal case IS a failure.
Seed script output uses emoji indicators and labeled counts. Acceptable for internal tooling; no formal output contract needed.
No user-facing UI or HTTP API contract surfaces exist in this phase.
handoff: Phase 1 Review-C complete. No blocking findings. UX/API applicability: NOT APPLICABLE — this is CLI/seed/test-infra work with no user-facing surfaces. The migration-ledger-doctor CLI contract is well-defined: exit 0=ok, exit 1=fail-closed (behind/divergence/typo), exit 2=usage/connection error. Messages are labeled and grep-parseable. Flag/env contract documented in JSDoc, usage line, and plan.md. Seed scripts emit operator-facing console output which is acceptable for internal tooling. All 22 targeted tests pass (15 deploy-gate + governance, 7 codecamp seed).
